notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W2-Q01 'Successive side road junction on a curve' warning sign (2013, rev B), (L) and (R) drawn side by side with a detail of each arrow; (L) is the drawn hand, (R) the mirror image. Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750, C 900, D 1200 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 8 yellow edge + c 16 black border (b and c are dimensioned as separate spans on this sheet: b the outer yellow strip, c the black band; the sheet's vectors draw them in the ratio 1:2). Arrow: d 216 from the horizontal centreline down to the stem bottom, e 60 from the vertical centreline to the stem's near (inner) edge, stem g 88 wide, arc centre f 188 across / h 72 up from the stem bottom corner, side roads k 120 x m 64 at 15 and 40 degrees, arrow head A a 232 x b 192, c 16 notch, r 16. The arrow is the sheet PDF's own filled vector path (tools/symbols/qld_w2-q01_arrow.svg, vec2sym, not traced; the sheet also strokes it 2.4 mm, fill only taken): measured on the sheet it is at the tabled A geometry (stem 90.7, branch 124 x 66, stem inner edge 61.6 from the centreline, stem bottom 222 below the centreline), so the drawn path is placed with its stem bottom at d 216 and its inner edge at e 60 (box x 177.2, y 214.4, 514.3 x 425.9). Black on retroreflective yellow.
